status: PACKAGES. I did not make the merge. The sandbox keeps `.claude/` (agents, hooks, skills) and `.tickets/` read-only, and the merge writes about 1,000 files there, so `git merge` would have failed part-way. EMG-d4b-launched.md also says "Do not merge `w2/integrate` yourself". I checked write access with `test -w` and never started a merge. The worktree is clean at `73c18fea1e1f`, with no MERGE_HEAD.
work_completed: I resolved the three conflicts as RESOLUTION.md says, but in a scratch export of the merge result, not in the worktree. The resolved files and a step-by-step apply note are in `/tmp/gov-launch-independent-test-designer-ffkxbszq/claude-1000/d4b-w290b/resolved/` and `/tmp/gov-launch-independent-test-designer-ffkxbszq/claude-1000/d4b-w290b/APPLY.md`. (1) W1-47: integrate's side; the now-unused `install_editable_gov` and `EDITABLE_PYTHON` are removed, so the file is byte for byte integrate's. (2) W2-90: integrate's whole `install_gov_for`, and the unused `EDITABLE_PYTHON` is removed. (3) W1-33: integrate's rewritten not-a-worker case (with its `ready` parameter) now runs on `kernel_launch` and `kernel_project`, and `kernel_launch` plants the open gate the way integrate's conftest `launch` does. No case was deleted, skipped or weakened.
files_changed: none in the worktree or on any branch. Scratch only: the three resolved files, a `SHA256SUMS` file and `APPLY.md`.
evidence: no merge commit exists. Integrate has moved to `df77a459e980` since RESOLUTION.md measured `9d288f1b1c49`; `git merge-tree` still shows exactly the three named conflicts, no other (result tree `ce6195e525e5`). The resolved tree is `a17eb82e5c1f`. I made a scratch replica merge commit `27e220e8f751` (parents `73c18fea1e1f` and `df77a459e980`) in a throwaway repo under my TMPDIR. On it, `test -e .claude/templates/role-lead.md` is true. No conflict markers remain; the only match is test data in `tests/unit/hooks/test_live_hook.py`, identical to integrate's. Scoped runs through heavy_slot.sh, with HOME set to an empty folder: W1-33 111 passed, 1 skipped (the skipped case then passed with `RULESYNC_BIN`: `test_w1_33_agent_definitions.py`, 33 passed); W1-47 102 passed, plus its 6 time-limit cases passed; W1-05 30 passed; W1-46 122 passed; W2-59 46 passed; W2-65 14 passed; W2-54 64 passed and 3 failed in the flat export. Those 3 are `test_w2_54_audit_report.py`'s `[HEAD]` cases, which need W2-54's own commits in HEAD's history; on the replica merge history that file gives 20 passed, 4 deselected. W2-90's folder holds no cases (pytest exit 5, "no tests ran"). Scratch use: `du -sh` 111M, `du -s --inodes` 13916.
tests: I wrote no new tests. Every folder run used `-m "not local_only" -k "not real and not green_here and not time_limit"`. That left out 15 `local_only` cases (W1-46 live sessions ×12, one each in W2-54 sandboxed worker, W2-59 baseline and W2-59 project root) and 19 W2-54 name-excluded cases (green_here ×8, the real-embedder query-vector case, time_limit ×10). The CTO runs those outside the sandbox. I did not run `tests/unit/launch/test_runs.py`: no unit suite was in scope.
discoveries: (1) The brief and EMG-d4b-launched.md disagree: in this sandbox a launched test designer cannot merge `w2/integrate`. (2) The first run in an export without `.git` gave errors in every suite that builds a project, because `git ls-files` fails without a repository. A scratch repo fixed them all, so they say nothing about the merge.
risks: integrate may move again before the CTO merges. The tree check in APPLY.md (`git write-tree` = `a17eb82e5c1f`) holds only if integrate is still at `df77a459e980`. If it has moved, the three files still apply as long as the merge shows no new conflict in them. My runs used a scratch copy, not the worktree's own merge, so the CTO's scoped run after the merge is the binding check.
lessons: before a launched worker starts a merge, check write access to every path the merge touches (`test -w`). A read-only path breaks the merge part-way through.
proposed_decisions: none.
unresolved: the README prose corrections RESOLUTION.md lists under "After the three files" are not done: `tests/acceptance/W2-90b/README.md` lines 28 and 36 still say `install_editable_gov` (should say `plant_pinned_gov`), and so does the "next round" sentence in `tests/acceptance/W2-90/README.md`. The brief said "nothing else", so I left them. Separately, the merge commit's `Role: independent-test-designer` trailer needs a decision from the CTO, because the CTO would be the one making the commit.
recommended_next_action: the CTO makes the merge outside the sandbox and follows APPLY.md: `git merge --no-ff --no-commit w2/integrate`, check `SHA256SUMS`, copy in the three files and `git add` them, check `git write-tree` = `a17eb82e5c1f`, run the scoped suites, then commit with the brief's message and trailers. After that, a short designer round (or the land lead) fixes the two README sentences.
